text:
alex: Rolling a regional routing change for eu-west at 2026-03-20T16:00Z. Who can own the deploy window and watch smoke? Plan: 15% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m.

 taylor: I'm on for 16:00. will kick off canary and watch latency + errors. what's the exact policy id?

 alex: Policy is `eu-west-steer-v3`. Canary plan: 15m @15%, 10m @50%, then full. TTL set to 60s already (thanks sam).

 jen: Quick smoke checklist (short):
 - deploy canary
 - run gateway health curl
 - check p95 and 5xx rate
 - sanity traces for auth/login flows
 - verify KV-cache hit % doesn't tank

 jen: Health check snippet:
 ```
 curl -sS -D - https://api.eu-west.example/health | grep HTTP
 ```

 sam: DNS update done, TTL 60s. propagation expected ~2-3m; I also prepped cache purge command if needed. I'll watch BGP/NAT egress.

 taylor: Rollback plan? want the concise steps here so anyone can flip if we hit thresholds.

 alex: Rollback (single-step):
 1) flip policy back to `eu-west-steer-v2`
 2) run `orion purge --region eu-west` to invalidate route cache
 3) scale down new target pool and set traffic to legacy pool

 jen: Immediate rollback triggers (call to action):
 - 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m
 - p95 latency +200ms vs baseline
 - auth errors growth >50% or critical trace errors appear

 deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by alex at 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z. Reminder in 15 minutes. :rocket:

 taylor: I'll post a short status after the 15% hold with p95/5xx numbers. tagging @sam to confirm DNS hold before canary.

 sam: Confirmed TTL 60s and purge command is ready. I'll signal if I see route flaps.

 alex: Thanks — keep updates brief here. If anything looks off, call on the phone now instead of waiting (intent to abort). :phone:
